parameters.query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `messenger`.`ai_employee_memory` (`id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `employee_id` INT NOT NULL, `topic` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general', `summary` TEXT NOT NULL, `last_request` TEXT NULL, `request_count` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `updated_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `created_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE KEY `uq_emp_topic` (`employee_id`, `topic`), KEY `idx_employee_id` (`employee_id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
SELECT setting_value FROM messenger.ai_settings WHERE setting_key = 'ai_user_id' LIMIT 1

=`SELECT Id, usercode, name, position, department, COALESCE(privilage,'0') AS privilage, COALESCE(VLbal,0) AS VLbal, COALESCE(SLbal,0) AS SLbal, COALESCE(OLbal,0) AS OLbal FROM it_program.usertb WHERE Id = ${parseInt($('SAM Webhook').first().json.user_id)} LIMIT 1`

=`SELECT SenderID, MessageText, SentAt, MessageID FROM (SELECT SenderID, MessageText, SentAt, MessageID FROM messenger.messages WHERE ConversationID = ${parseInt($('SAM Webhook').first().json.conversation_id)} ORDER BY SentAt DESC, MessageID DESC LIMIT 25) recent ORDER BY SentAt ASC, MessageID ASC`

=`SELECT title, content FROM messenger.ai_knowledge_base WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE LOWER('%${String($json.lastMessage || '').substring(0,60).replace(/'/g, "''")}%') OR LOWER(content) LIKE LOWER('%${String($json.lastMessage || '').substring(0,60).replace(/'/g, "''")}%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5`
=`SELECT topic, summary, request_count FROM messenger.ai_employee_memory WHERE employee_id = ${parseInt($json.userId)} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 10`
